description: Per-system-role ratchets checked by the role-assumption-reachability gate (scripts/analyze_role_assumptions.ts): reachable unresolved ("any role") role-assumption sites (unresolved_sites) and child-process entries that inherit SYSTEM_ROLE (child_process_entries). A role fails when its count rises above its number, and the gate warns when the count falls below it — lower it then. Regenerate with `node --import ./scripts/ts-loader.mjs scripts/analyze_role_assumptions.ts --print-unresolved-baseline > knowledge/product/governance/role-assumption-unresolved-baseline.json`.
